Need Special Assistance?

For security reports or legal inquiries, reach out directly to security operations.

Contact Security

1. Our Security Commitment

We welcome security researchers and ethical hackers to test and report any vulnerabilities discovered within aimadulislam.dpdns.org. We are committed to working constructively with the security community to validate and resolve confirmed issues promptly.

2. Guidelines for Testing

To qualify for safe harbor under this policy, security researchers must adhere to the following principles:

  • Do NOT attempt Denial of Service (DoS/DDoS) attacks, brute-force spamming, or social engineering against domain administrators.
  • Do NOT modify or destroy user data or system integrity.
  • Provide detailed proof-of-concept steps to enable verification.
  • Allow us reasonable time (up to 30 days) to remediate vulnerabilities before public disclosure.

3. Reporting Channel

Please transmit vulnerability disclosures to our security operations team via encrypted email:

Encrypted Reporting Email
Email: info@aimadulislam.dpdns.org
PGP Fingerprint: 4F8C 9E12 3B45 D678 9A01 2345 6789 ABCD EF01 2345

4. Response SLA

  • Initial Acknowledgment: Within 24 Hours
  • Triage & Validation: Within 72 Hours
  • Fix Deployment & Public Credit: Within 14 Days
